title: JOOPITER Head of Sales on Michael Jordan Jersey Auction
summary: Caitlin Donovan, the Global Head of Sales at JOOPITER, discusses the rapid growth of sports memorabilia as an alternative asset class, saying the category is one of the fastest-growing parts of the collectibles market. JOOPITER, the digital auction house founded by Pharrell Williams in 2022, has put a game-worn Michael Jordan jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals on the market with an opening bid of $10 million. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Oil Remains Primary Risk Driving Higher Rates Says Haworth
summary:
Treasuries fell as anticipation of additional Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes stoked interest in wagers on rising yields for short-maturity debt. Rob Haworth, Senior Investment Strategy Director at U.S. Bank Asset Management joins Bloomberg Businessweek Daily to discuss the markets as well as how the oil is driving rates higher.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US and China Vie For AI Lead Before Trump- Xi Summit
summary: Less than a week before Chinese leader Xi Jinping travels to the US to meet President Donald Trump, AI has taken center stage in the bilateral relationship. In some ways the rivalry is straightforward. Most benchmarks show American models have a lead in performance that Washington very much wants to maintain, for military and economic reasons. Anja Manuel, Aspen Strategy Group Executive Director joins to discuss the upcoming meeting between the two leaders as well as what to expect from the UN General Assembly next week. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: KKR’s McVey Favors Private Markets as Traditional Hedges Crumble
